glossary.source_title: Section 901.76 - Tampering with or sabotaging livestock at an exhibition prohibited.

glossary.definition: (2) "Sabotage" means intentionally tampering with any livestock belonging to or owned by another person that has been registered, entered in, or exhibited in any exhibition, or raised with the apparent intent of being entered in an exhibition.
